problem.passage:
In the figure, lines $m$ and $n$ are parallel, and line $k$ is a transversal that intersects them. The angle marked $37^\circ$ is formed at the intersection of line $k$ and line $m$, and the angle marked $x^\circ$ is formed at the intersection of line $k$ and line $n$, on the same side of line $k$ and between lines $m$ and $n$ as consecutive interior angles with the $37^\circ$ angle.

What is the value of $x$?
problem.stimulus: In the figure, lines $m$ and $n$ are parallel, and line $k$ is a transversal that intersects them. The angle marked $37^\circ$ is formed at the intersection of line $k$ and line $m$, and the angle marked $x^\circ$ is formed at the intersection of line $k$ and line $n$, on the same side of line $k$ and between lines $m$ and $n$ as consecutive interior angles with the $37^\circ$ angle.
problem.question: What is the value of $x$?
problem.explanation: 두 평행선 m, n을 횡단선 k가 자를 때, 37° 각과 x° 각은 같은 쪽에서 두 평행선 사이(내부)에 놓인 동측내각(co-interior angles, 또는 same-side interior angles) 관계이다. 동측내각은 서로 보각(합이 180°)이므로 x = 180 - 37 = 143이다. 정답은 D번이다. (A는 엇각으로 착각해 37을 그대로 쓴 오답, B는 90-37을 계산한 오답, C는 직각으로 착각한 오답이다.)
problem.explanationEn: When transversal k crosses parallel lines m and n, the 37° angle and the x° angle lie on the same side of the transversal, between the two parallel lines — this makes them co-interior (same-side interior) angles. Co-interior angles are supplementary, so x = 180 - 37 = 143. The correct answer is D. (A mistakenly treats them as equal alternate angles, B computes 90 - 37, and C assumes a right angle relationship.)

distractorRationales.plausible_because: students often assume any two angles formed by a transversal with parallel lines are simply equal, as with alternate interior or corresponding angles
distractorRationales.why_wrong: the two marked angles are co-interior (same-side interior), which are supplementary, not equal

distractorRationales.matches: the given 37° value combined with a right-angle assumption
distractorRationales.plausible_because: students may incorrectly assume the angles form a right angle together and subtract from 90
distractorRationales.why_wrong: there is no right-angle relationship indicated between these two angles; the correct relationship is supplementary (sum to 180°), not complementary (sum to 90°)

distractorRationales.matches: the general appearance of the transversal crossing figure
distractorRationales.plausible_because: 90° is a common 'default' angle value students guess when unsure of the actual relationship
distractorRationales.why_wrong: nothing in the figure indicates a right angle at either intersection

difficultyReasons: 동측내각(같은 쪽 내각)의 성질(합이 180°)만 알면 한 단계로 풀 수 있음
평행선과 횡단선의 기본 각 관계 하나만 적용하면 되므로 easy에 해당

distractors.plausibleBecause: 평행선 문제에서 대응각/엇각이 같은 경우가 많아 37을 그대로 답으로 고를 수 있음
distractors.whyWrong: 37°와 x°는 동측내각(같은 쪽 내각) 관계이므로 합이 180°가 되어야 하며 서로 같지 않음

distractors.plausibleBecause: 90-37=53을 계산하여 여각 관계로 착각할 수 있음
distractors.whyWrong: 동측내각은 여각(합이 90°) 관계가 아니라 보각(합이 180°) 관계이므로 53은 틀림

distractors.plausibleBecause: 직각이라는 오개념(횡단선이 수직이라고 착각) 또는 단순히 90이라는 특수각을 선택
distractors.matches: 교차하는 선이라는 설정과 관련하여 직각을 연상
distractors.whyWrong: 횡단선이 수직이라는 정보가 없고, 동측내각 관계상 90이 될 이유가 없음
